dashboard_still_loading: Still loading older entries, so this may rise.
day_detail_nothing_logged: No time logged on this day.
day_feed_empty: No time logged in GitLab yet.
insights_nothing_in_period: Nothing logged in this month yet.
insights_working_day_empty: a working day with nothing logged
not_configured_description: The dashboard needs the Application ID of an OAuth application in your own GitLab account. It is a public value: there is no secret to protect.
not_configured_step_create: In GitLab, open User Settings, then Applications, and add a new application.
not_configured_step_env: Put the Application ID in VITE_GITLAB_CLIENT_ID and rebuild.
not_configured_step_public: Leave Confidential unchecked and tick the read_api and openid scopes.
not_configured_title: This build has no GitLab application
opens_in_new_tab: Opens GitLab in a new tab
report_failed_rejected: GitLab refused the request. These figures are the last ones loaded.
report_failed_unauthorized: GitLab no longer accepts this session. Sign in again to refresh these figures.
report_failed_unavailable: GitLab could not be reached. These figures are the last ones loaded.
report_unread: Entries GitLab could not read: {count}. The figures are short by them.
settings_description: These change how your hours are counted and shown. They are kept on this device only.
settings_schedule_description: How many hours a full day is, and which time zone decides when a day starts.
settings_teams_description: Who is on each team, and which people a month of hours covers.
sign_in_failed_denied: You did not grant access, so there is nothing to show yet.
sign_in_failed_expired: That sign-in link is no longer valid.
sign_in_failed_identity: This sign-in did not include permission to identify you, which saved teams need. Signing in again grants it.
sign_in_failed_state_mismatch: This sign-in could not be verified as one you started. Nothing was signed in.
sign_in_failed_unavailable: GitLab could not be reached. Nothing was signed in.
team_cell_unknown: Nothing is known about this person.
team_cell_unreadable_anywhere: Nothing here that you can read.
team_cell_unreadable_in_group: Nothing in this group that you can read.
team_empty_team: Nobody is on this team yet. Add people to see their hours.
team_group_none: No group you can open matches that.
team_legend_unlogged_in_group: Working day, nothing in this group
team_none_yet: You have no teams yet. Build one to see a month of hours.
team_reconnect: Your teams need permission to identify you, which this sign-in did not include. Sign in again to grant it — you will come back here.
team_reference_legend: Bars measured against {hours} h a day
team_scope_everywhere: Every hour GitLab will show you for these people, wherever they logged it.
team_store_unavailable: Your teams could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
team_table_caption_everywhere: Hours logged per person per day. {team}, {month}. Rows are people, columns are days of the month grouped by ISO week. Figures are decimal hours and cover every hour GitLab will show you for these people, wherever they logged it, including work this account cannot open.
team_table_caption_group: Hours logged per person per day. {team}, {month}. Rows are people, columns are days of the month grouped by ISO week. Figures are decimal hours; they cover only issues and merge requests in {group} and its subgroups, and may include time logged on work this account cannot open.
team_unknown_team: That team is not one of yours. It may have been deleted.
team_unreadable_group: The group your link narrows to could not be read with your account, so these figures cover everywhere instead.
teams_changed_elsewhere: Your teams were changed somewhere else, so this is now that version. Your change was not saved.
teams_description: A team is a list of people you keep. A month of hours covers everyone on it, wherever they logged the time.
teams_group_incomplete: That group has more entries than were read, so these may not be everybody.
teams_name_invalid: A name is needed, up to {max} characters.
teams_no_members: Nobody yet. Add people from a group, or search for them by name.
teams_reconnect: Your teams need permission to identify you, which this sign-in did not include. Sign in again to grant it — you will come back here.
teams_save_failed: That change could not be saved. Try again.
teams_start_description: Choose a group and everyone who logged time in it since {since} joins the team. You can change who is on it afterwards.
teams_start_heading: Start a team from a GitLab group
teams_unavailable: Your teams could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
theme_switch_to_dark: Switch to the dark colour scheme
theme_switch_to_light: Switch to the light colour scheme
time_zone_description: An entry logged late at night belongs to the day it was still, here.
